items.quote: And Abraham took Ishmael his son, and all that were born in his house, and all that were bought with his money, every male among the men of Abraham’s house; and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the selfsame day, as God had said unto him.
items.claim: According to the text (verse 17:23), Abraham circumcised his son Ishmael and every male in his household, both those born in the house and those bought with money, all on the same day, as God had told him to.
items.object: Ishmael and every male of Abraham's household, born in the house or bought with money
items.mechanism: obeying a divine command ('as God had said unto him')
